Residency Requirement: Applicants must be permanent residents of the Ward/Gram Sabha of the vacant post. In cases where no eligible candidate from the said category is available in the Gram Sabha, applicants must be permanent residents of the concerned Nyaya Panchayat.
Age Limit: The age of applicants should be between 18 years (minimum) and 35 years (maximum) as of the cut-off date, which is 01.01.2026.
Application Process: Online application forms for the posts will be accepted exclusively on the departmental website http://upanganwadibharti.in within the specified time period.
Application Deadline: The last date to apply online for the posts depends on the notifications. Please check the notification from the links given below.

Detailed Information: For detailed eligibility criteria, application process, and more information regarding the above-mentioned posts, please visit the departmental website http://upanganwadibharti.in.
